INSERT INTO interview_scenario ( room_id, scenario_type, parent_scenario_id, question_seq, turn_order, turn_role, turn_ref_id, speech_text, timeout_sec ) VALUES
( #{item.roomId}, #{item.scenarioType}, #{item.parentScenarioId}, #{item.questionSeq}, #{item.turnOrder}, #{item.turnRole}, #{item.turnRefId}, #{item.speechText}, #{item.timeoutSec} )
mapper.select: SELECT scenario_id, room_id, scenario_type, parent_scenario_id, question_seq, turn_order, turn_role, turn_ref_id, speech_text, answer_text, answer_sec, timeout_sec FROM interview_scenario WHERE room_id = #{roomId} ORDER BY turn_order

SELECT s.scenario_id, s.speech_text, s.turn_role, s.turn_ref_id, COALESCE(ai.voice_type, ap.voice_type) AS voice_type FROM interview_scenario s LEFT JOIN ai_interviewer ai ON s.turn_role = 'INTERVIEWER' AND ai.interviewer_id = s.turn_ref_id LEFT JOIN ai_applicant ap ON s.turn_role = 'APPLICANT' AND ap.applicant_id = s.turn_ref_id WHERE s.scenario_id = #{scenarioId}
